name: stage_replenishment_plan
description: Replace the replenishment lines in the open editor and optionally update title, analysis summary or JPY budget. Validates against purchasing rules, then stages the draft for merchant review. Does not register or save a request.

name: update_replenishment_line
description: Adjust quantity or purchasing reason for an existing SKU in the open draft. The app validates and stages the change. The merchant must click Register request to persist it.

name: get_staged_replenishment_plan
description: Read the current draft and registration state. List responses shorten reasons to 80 characters and summary to 300. Supply a sku to read that line's full purchasing reason before editing it.
